## InMemoryFxRateProvider

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Execution.MultiCurrency.InMemoryFxRateProvider</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution/MultiCurrency/InMemoryFxRateProvider.cs:19](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution/MultiCurrency/InMemoryFxRateProvider.cs#L19).

A deterministic, in-memory IFxRateProvider backed by a seeded set of FxRate quotes. It resolves a requested pair through four strategies, in order: identity — a currency against itself is always 1; direct — a seeded quote for the exact pair; inverse — a seeded quote for the reversed pair, inverted; triangulation — legs through a configured pivot currency (e.g. USD). Quotes are selected as-of a point in time: the most recent quote whose timestamp is at or before the requested instant. When every quote for a pair post-dates the requested instant, no rate was known as of that time and the provider reports none rather than a future quote, so callers fail closed instead of leaking look-ahead information. The provider performs no network I/O and no wall-clock reads, so results are fully reproducible for a given seed — a property the reconciliation and ledger layers rely on.

```csharp
public sealed class InMemoryFxRateProvider : IFxRateProvider
```

## PaperOrderMatchingPolicy

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Execution.PaperMatching.PaperOrderMatchingPolicy</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution/PaperMatching/PaperOrderMatchingPolicy.cs:59](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution/PaperMatching/PaperOrderMatchingPolicy.cs#L59).

Order-type-aware paper matching over observed market data. This is the documented matching policy (MatchingModelVersion) shared by both paper gateways: Market orders fill from observed market data only — buys at the observed ask (falling back to last trade, then bar close), sells at the observed bid (same fallbacks). With no observation the order does not fill; the gateway decides whether to reject (default, fail closed) or apply explicitly opted-in scaffold pricing. Limit orders fill only at or better than the limit price: a buy fills when the observed aggressive price is at or below the limit, at that observed price; a sell fills when the observed aggressive price is at or above the limit. Otherwise the order rests and is re-evaluated as new market data arrives. Stop triggers are trade-preferred: a buy stop triggers when the last trade (or bar close) is at or above the stop price, a sell stop when at or below. When no trade or bar has been observed, the quote fallback applies: a buy stop triggers on ask, a sell stop on bid. A triggered stop-market order fills with market semantics; a triggered stop-limit order fills with limit semantics. Every fill price is clamped into the observed price envelope (PaperMarketObservation.EnvelopeLow .. PaperMarketObservation.EnvelopeHigh) — a paper fill can never print outside the observed market data in effect. Partial fills are not modeled: an order fills in full or rests.

## PaperTradingGateway

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Execution.PaperTradingGateway</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution/PaperTradingGateway.cs:28](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution/PaperTradingGateway.cs#L28).

Simulated execution gateway for paper trading. Orders are matched against observed market data under PaperOrderMatchingPolicy: market orders fill from the observed bid/ask/trade/bar in effect, limit orders fill only at or better than their limit price, stop orders trigger per the documented trade-preferred policy, and unmarketable limit/stop orders rest in this gateway and re-evaluate as new market data arrives — resting fills are delivered through StreamExecutionReportsAsync. Commission, fee, and slippage costs from PaperTradingCostModel apply to every fill. Market orders with no observed price are rejected, unless scaffold pricing is explicitly enabled via Adapters.PaperTradingGatewayOptions.AllowScaffoldMarketFills, in which case they fill at the configured scaffold notional price. Cancel and modify act only on orders currently resting in this gateway; an unknown order id is rejected rather than acknowledged.

```csharp
public sealed class PaperTradingGateway : IExecutionGateway, IExecutionGatewayModeProvider, IFaceValueOrderSizingGateway, Interfaces.IPaperFillEvaluationTrigger, IAsyncDisposable
```
